grid.order: dy major; dx minor; each offset is [dx,dy]

cost_tie.selection: cost <= minimum+1e-12; smallest norm squared, then dx, then dy

design.nearest_axis_tie: minimum exact absolute distance; smallest absolute ordinate, then smaller ordinate

readout_rules.min2d: Original 625-candidate minimum; must replay every archived prediction exactly.
readout_rules.oracle_gt_y: Use nearest grid row to original GT dy; minimize its 25 dx candidates.
readout_rules.zero_y: Use dy=0 row; minimize its 25 dx candidates.
readout_rules.oracle_gt_x: Use nearest grid column to original GT dx; minimize its 25 dy candidates.
readout_rules.mismatched_gt_y: Donor world=(world_index+37)%256, preserving variant/object; nearest donor GT dy row, minimize dx. All methods use the same donors.

design.rank: 1 + count(cost < nearest-GT-grid cost - 1e-12); tie count uses absolute difference <=1e-12. Report globally and within original GT-y row.
design.margins: GT-grid cost minus actual minimum, and GT-grid cost minus best other candidate; global and GT-y row. Negative best-other margin means GT grid is strictly better.
design.geometric_lower_bound: Nearest grid point to continuous GT, independent of costs; lower bound only for predictors restricted to this finite grid.

metrics.skill: Mean of four per-axis 1-MSE/mean((GT-frozen FIT mean)^2); never Dev-centered variance.
metrics.oracle_primary: oracle_gt_y and mismatched_gt_y: dx; oracle_gt_x: dy. Full4D scores contain the supplied privileged coordinate.
metrics.direction: abs(GT dx pixels)>=1 inclusive; correct=product>0, wrong=product<0, zero=prediction==0. Non-correct=wrong+zero. GT zero and 0<abs(GT)<1 reported separately.

bootstrap.interval: two-sided percentile95%; resample whole worlds preserving both variants and objects; same draws for all comparisons; conditional on these costs/readers, no multiplicity correction

design.effects: min2d minus each alternative MSE (dx/dy/4D), and mismatched_gt_y minus oracle_gt_y dx MSE; direction rescue/harm/net rates with whole-world ratio bootstrap. Report donor/true quantized-row equality; additionally report different-row dx effect with whole-world ratio bootstrap preserving its denominator. Donor-world mismatch does not imply a different y row.
design.limits: Privileged posthoc known-Dev localization, not a deployable reader, new confirmation, or module responsibility/explained-error fraction. Nearest-grid cost rank describes this fixed surface and cannot establish descriptor information absence.

tests: V56 cost tie and row subset
